summary: The Time24Hour system provides functionality for handling, validating, and manipulating 24-hour time representations. It includes methods for calculating shift lengths, validating times and time periods, determining shift based on time, and converting time to decimal format.
purpose: To facilitate the handling and management of 24-hour time representations in scheduling and shift management applications.

workflows.name: Calculate Shift Length
steps: Convert StartTime and EndTime to decimal.
Return difference as a decimal rounded to two places.

workflows.name: Validate Time
steps: Check if time is 4 digits and numeric.
Check if last two digits are between 0 and 59.

workflows.name: Determine Valid Time Period
steps: Check if end is greater than start or crosses midnight.
Ensure shift doesn't exceed 12 hours if crossing midnight.

workflows.name: Parse Shift
steps: Determine shift based on time range and shift code.

validations.name: 24-hour Time Validation
validations.details: Ensure time is a valid 4-digit representation between 0000 and 2400 with last two digits under 60.

calculations.detail: Calculate hours difference between two 24-hour times.

conditions.condition: End is less than start, add 24 to end to account for crossing midnight.

system_behavior.behavior: Converts 24-hour times to decimal for calculations.
Validates time format and sequence for scheduling.

exceptions.exception: Invalid time returns true for period validity to prevent redundant errors.
